notes.title: The Score Update
notes.content:
Introducing the Score Update!
The Great Plague Exodus was always intended as a replayable game, with enough random events to cover two playthroughs without repeating and multiple options to form your family; The Great Plague Exodus was meant to be enjoyed again and again.

Following feedback from the player base, we've been working hard to implement a much loved feature from Silk Roads: Caravan Kings, a score system for the game. Now when you reach the end of the game, not only do you have a series of text boxes describing how each member of your family went forward with their lives after the game, you'll also be given a score based on family survival, total money and the value of the items in your inventory.

With this new score, you'll have a target for your next playthrough which can help you to experiment more, larger families means more points, but more bellies to feed means less money which means less points. Of course, there is still plenty to enjoy if leaderboards aren't your thing, and you can continue to survive in your own way. As always, it's all up to you!

Happy surviving!

notes.title: Activity Description Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39473385/1e0c1934dda672fab267fbf3f33bc0fe3aab7839.png
Following on from the stabilisation of the game after issues surrounding certain events causing instability we have now added a description for each of the activities that can be found in the Character Interaction menu.
This should help players to better understand the effect of certain activities and make more educated decisions as they struggle to survive.

notes.title: Day 2 Patch
notes.content: Today's patch focuses on an issue players have been having with morale/health/death with text not updating on option selecting and crashes occurring. Please let me know if issues persist but this should eliminate most problems.

notes.title: Small Release Day Patch
notes.content:
Good day survivors!

Just pushing out a quick hot-fix for The Great Plague Exodus to address a few of the issues brought up since launch.

Please continue sharing any issues/complaints/thoughts in the discussions area of the Steam page and they will be swiftly addressed.

Enjoy!
